next.reason: The ban is the same, but the result of breaking it is now defined. 1985: between INITIATE and TERMINATE 'no input-output statement may be executed which references that report file'; 1985 XIII.3.3.3 SR3 already allows only USE, CLOSE and OPEN OUTPUT/EXTEND to name a report file, so the ban meant OPEN and CLOSE. 2023 §2023:13.18.46.4 GR2 'no OPEN or CLOSE statements shall be executed that reference the report file', with the same reference limit in §2023:13.18.46.3 SR3 and §2023:13.4.5.3 SR9 (the store's 'other I-O statements no longer refused' is wrong: they are refused at compile time in both). Difference: 1985 leaves a violating CLOSE undefined; 2023 §2023:14.9.6.4 GR5 completes the CLOSE and sets EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED.
